name: Hindi Gita Satsang
description:
Hindi Gita Satsang

Sponsor: Lakshmi & Rao Arimilli, Srilalitha & Siva Prasad Jaldanki, Shilpi Rebba & Srirekha Malladi, RadhaKalyani & Shashikanth Mantripragada, Mita & Axay Rana, Harisree & Ganesh Sivaraman, Swapna & Ravi Tadikonda, Uma & Ram Venkataraman

HCC welcomes Brahmacari Pratyagatma Chaitanya for a special satsang and Gita discourse. He is a teacher at Arsha Vidya Gurukulam and shares the wisdom of Vedanta through satsangs, Gita study, temple talks, and university lectures. Deepen your understanding of the Bhagavad Gita and learn how its timeless teachings guide us toward clarity, right action, and success in life. Please join with family and friends.
